name: List
description: Stacked feature sections, each with an optional divider, an icon + bold title row, and an indented list of supporting items. Used inside MerchCard to show what's included in a plan.

props.name: sections
props.type: Array<{ title: string, icon?: TemplateResult, divider?: boolean, items: string[] }>
props.description: Section descriptors. title = Figma TEXT prop, icon = Figma INSTANCE_SWAP prop (20x20), divider = Figma 'Show Divider' BOOLEAN prop, items = Figma .items SLOT of ListItem instances.

notes: Figma binds primitive spacing variables (s2a/spacing/2, /8, /12, /16, /32); CSS uses the semantic aliases at the same px values (3xs=2, xs=8, sm=12, md=16, xl=32) per the repo's semantic-tokens-only rule.

The Figma divider is a Divider/Style=subtle instance whose fill token s2a/color/divider/subtle emits codeSyntax var(--s2a-color-border-subtle); rendered here as a self-contained <hr> bound to that same custom property.
The --s2a-hover-list-* tokens from tokens 0.0.21 belong to a different hover-list pattern and are NOT used by this Figma component; none are bound here.
Items render as <li> inside a <ul> with list-style removed via CSS; each section is a <section> landmark grouping divider, title, and items.
Section icons are decorative and wrapped in a span with aria-hidden='true'.
